text.p: Donnelley Enterprise Solutions Inc said Tuesday it completed an initial 2,860,000 share offering that raised $43.4 million.

Of the total, 1,855,000 shares were offered by Donnelley Enterprise and 1,005,000 by R.R. Donnelley & Sons Co, former parent of Donnelley Enterprise which continues to hold 42.8 percent of Donnelley Entereprise's total shares.
As a result, there are five million shares of Donnelley Enterprise Solutions common stock outstanding.
R.R. Donnelley has granted underwriters an overallotment option to buy up to 429,000 more shares through November 29.
Donnelley Enterprise, which provides information management software to professional service organizations, said it will use proceeds from the offering to pay down debt.
